mentions.name: ECG Interpretation Automation Tool
mentions.description: This tool automates part of a physician's workflow by assisting with ECG interpretation, aiming to free up doctors' working time and help save lives.
mentions.problem: Doctors spend significant working time on ECG interpretation.
mentions.audience: Doctors and medical professionals who interpret ECGs
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a tool that can automate part of my work. If it works well it can free doctor working time and save lives too. It's related to ECG interpretation.
